rendered: The pan-genome analysis covered 45 isolates[1]. It found 19,469 total genes[2], of which only 3155[3] were core genes (about ~16.2%[4] of the total). This matches the pangenome panel of the figure, which shows the core genome as 3155[5] genes under the definition used in that study Fig. 2[6].

source.caption: Fig. 2. Phenotypic characteristics and genomic diversity of S. marcescens.
